name: LPP S.A.
summary: LPP S.A. operates as a leading fashion enterprise, overseeing the entire process from conceptualizing and producing garments to their distribution and final sale for women, men, and children. The company's extensive product line encompasses clothing, accessories, and footwear, marketed under its well-known brands: Reserved, Cropp, House, Mohito, and Sinsay. Customers can acquire these items through a broad network of 2,244 physical retail locations, as well as via its digital online storefronts, reaching consumers in Poland and worldwide. Founded in 1989, LPP S.A. is based in Gdansk, Poland.
